title: Senior embedded developer, truck ECU platform
brief:
# Assignment request: Senior embedded developer, truck ECU platform

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Developer for a major Swedish truck OEM. The role involves working on an advanced truck ECU platform designed to enhance vehicle performance and safety. You will join a dynamic team of engineers focused on delivering cutting-edge automotive solutions. The assignment is based in Gothenburg and will run for 12 months, with a start date approximately two months from now.

## Requirements
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Must have experience with AUTOSAR Classic
- Required proficiency in Embedded C
- Experience with CAN bus is essential
- Familiarity with ISO 26262 is required
- Must adhere to MISRA C standards

## Meriting
- Experience with Vector CANoe
- Knowledge of ASPICE
- Familiarity with Simulink
notes: Bread-and-butter automotive embedded profile; several strong matches should exist.

title: AUTOSAR Adaptive engineer, software-defined vehicle
brief:
# Assignment request: AUTOSAR Adaptive engineer, software-defined vehicle

We are seeking an experienced AUTOSAR Adaptive engineer for a Nordic passenger-car OEM based in Gothenburg. This project involves developing a software-defined vehicle platform, focusing on enhancing connectivity and autonomous driving capabilities. You will be joining a dynamic team that is at the forefront of automotive technology innovation. The assignment is scheduled to last for 18 months, with a start date approximately two months from now.

## Requirements
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Must have expertise in AUTOSAR Adaptive
- Proficiency in C++ is required
- Experience with SOME/IP is mandatory

## Meriting
- Knowledge of Ethernet TSN
- Familiarity with QNX
- Understanding of ISO 21434
- Experience with Yocto
notes: Small strong pool by design (adaptive is a scarcer skill); partials are classic-platform people.

title: 5G RAN developer, cloud-native baseband
brief:
# Assignment request: 5G RAN developer, cloud-native baseband

Our client, a Nordic telecom equipment vendor, is seeking a skilled developer to join their team in Stockholm (Kista) for a 12-month project. The company is at the forefront of 5G technology, focusing on cloud-native baseband solutions that enhance network efficiency and scalability. The team is expanding to meet the increasing demand for innovative 5G RAN solutions. The position is expected to start in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- Must have experience with 5G RAN.
- Proficiency in C++ or Golang is required.
- Must be familiar with Kubernetes.
- At least 3 years of relevant experience.

## Meriting
- Experience with O-RAN is a plus.
- Familiarity with DPDK.
- Knowledge of GitLab CI.
- Understanding of Helm.
notes: C++ or Golang both accepted; 5G Core people are the engineered near-miss (wrong network layer).

title: DevOps engineer, embedded build & test infrastructure
brief:
# Assignment request: DevOps engineer, embedded build & test infrastructure

We are seeking a DevOps engineer for a German premium car manufacturer. This role involves enhancing and maintaining the embedded build and test infrastructure for cutting-edge automotive technology. The successful candidate will join a dynamic team dedicated to innovation and excellence in vehicle development. The position is based in Gothenburg with a hybrid work model, and the assignment is set to last for 12 months, starting approximately in two months.

## Requirements
- Jenkins or GitLab CI
- Docker
- Python
- Yocto
- At least 3 years of relevant experience

## Meriting
- Artifactory
- Kubernetes
- dSPACE HIL
- Ansible
notes: Yocto in a CI context separates embedded DevOps from generic DevOps.

title: Cloud platform engineer, connected-vehicle backend
brief:
# Assignment request: Cloud platform engineer, connected-vehicle backend

We have a thrilling opportunity with a Swedish electric-vehicle startup, known for its innovative approach to connected-vehicle technology. This company is on the cutting edge of integrating cloud solutions with next-gen electric vehicles, aiming to redefine the driving experience through enhanced connectivity and smart features. The team is expanding to bolster their backend capabilities and is seeking a skilled engineer for a 9-month contract based in Stockholm, with flexibility for remote work. The project is expected to kick off in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- At least 4 years of relevant experience.
- Experience with AWS or Azure.
- Proficiency with Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with Terraform.

## Meriting
- Experience with Kafka.
- Knowledge of MQTT.
- Understanding of Helm.
- Proficiency in Golang.
- Experience from automotive or connected-vehicle projects is meriting but not required.
notes: Domain kept a soft preference on purpose: tests that the matcher does not over-filter on domain.

title: Embedded Linux BSP engineer, radio units
brief:
# Assignment request: Embedded Linux BSP engineer, radio units

We are seeking an Embedded Linux BSP engineer for a European 5G infrastructure vendor. The client is developing cutting-edge radio units that integrate seamlessly into next-generation networks. You'll be joining a dynamic team working on innovative solutions to enhance network performance and reliability. The assignment is for 12 months, based in Helsinki or remote, with an anticipated start in approximately two months.

## Requirements
- Embedded Linux
- Yocto
- Embedded C
- Device drivers
- At least 4 years of relevant experience

## Meriting
- Secure boot
- Rust
- Zephyr
- C++
notes: BSP work: driver experience is the discriminator.

title: Functional safety lead, ADAS platform
brief:
# Assignment request: Functional safety lead, ADAS platform

We are seeking a Functional Safety Lead for a tier-1 automotive supplier based in Gothenburg. The client is developing a next-generation Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) platform, which aims to enhance vehicle safety and autonomy. This project involves collaborating with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and safety experts to ensure compliance with industry standards. The assignment is expected to last 24 months, with a proposed start date approximately two months from now.

## Requirements
- At least 7 years of relevant experience.
- Proficiency in ISO 26262.
- Knowledge of MISRA C.
- Experience with ASPICE.
- Fluency in Swedish is mandatory.

## Meriting
- Experience with AUTOSAR Classic.
- Familiarity with ISO 21434.
- Proficiency in Vector CANoe.
- Knowledge of Simulink.
notes: Swedish is a hard requirement (safety audits and supplier meetings run in Swedish).

title: Edge platform engineer, secure telecom workloads
brief:
# Assignment request: Edge platform engineer, secure telecom workloads

We have an exciting opportunity with a Finnish network operator looking to enhance their edge platform capabilities to support secure telecom workloads. This project involves integrating advanced technologies to optimize 5G deployment and ensure robust security measures. The team is currently expanding to meet the demands of a rapidly growing market. The assignment is based in Helsinki and will last for a duration of 12 months, with a projected start date approximately two months from now.

## Requirements
- At least 5 years of relevant experience
- Expertise in 5G RAN or 5G Core
- Proficiency in Kubernetes
- Knowledge of secure boot

## Meriting
- Experience with DPDK
- Familiarity with Helm
- Understanding of GitLab CI
- Competence in Rust
notes: DELIBERATELY UNSATISFIABLE: no persona combines 5G + Kubernetes + secure boot. The correct output is an honest 'no full match' plus the nearest partials.

title: Inbyggd mjukvaruutvecklare, hyttelektronik
brief:
# Uppdragsförfrågan: Inbyggd mjukvaruutvecklare, hyttelektronik
En stor svensk lastbilstillverkare söker en erfaren inbyggd mjukvaruutvecklare för att stärka sitt team inom hyttelektronik. Teamet arbetar med att utveckla nästa generations styrsystem för lastbilshytter, med fokus på säkerhet och effektivitet. Uppdraget är beläget i Göteborg och förväntas starta om cirka två månader, med en varaktighet på 12 månader.

## Krav
- Minst 4 års relevant erfarenhet.
- Erfarenhet av AUTOSAR Classic.
- Kunskap i Embedded C.
- Erfarenhet av Vector CANoe.
- Svenska är ett krav för uppdraget.

## Meriterande
- Erfarenhet av LIN.
- Kunskap i Simulink.
- Erfarenhet av dSPACE HIL.
notes: CROSS-LINGUAL: the whole brief is written in Swedish (a Swedish client to a Swedish consultancy) while every CV is English. Technology names keep their canonical English spelling, so the taxonomy checks still hold; no OR-groups on purpose (the or-phrasing check is English-only). Tests that extraction and matching survive the language boundary.
